geoff.docs.pricing.model: One monthly token pool. Shared across text, speech, video, image, music, code, and files — no per-modality nickel-and-dime.

plans.name: Basic
plans.why: Chat + music + video + image + code — unlocked at $19.

plans.name: Pro
plans.why: The daily driver when Basic runs dry.

plans.name: Max
plans.why: Where Geoff stops being “another chat app.”

plans.name: Turbo
plans.why: For shops that print, don’t dabble.

estimates.note: Docs: approximate output if you spend the entire monthly balance on one capability
estimates.nsfwNote: Unfiltered requests such as NSFW use 10× tokens

matrix.label: Chat on web, iOS, Android, desktop
Maximum deep research and agent mode

wins.v: Text → video → music → code share one balance. Corps sell five meters.
Basic already includes music, video, images, code — not an enterprise upsell.
Seats, RPM/TPM, and yield estimates on docs.geoff.ai. Receipts, not vibes.
Max/Turbo open Mixture of Models + train-your-own — the Geoff differentiator.

models.description: SOTA music and media generation with creative AI capabilities
Advanced multimodal model with audio, vision and text capabilities
Companion reasoning brain — multimodal chat with deep reasoning
Companion reasoning brain (max tier) — 1M-context multimodal chat with deep reasoning

widgets.name: asset-report
widgets.description: Comprehensive crypto asset report with sentiment analysis, technical summary, key events/news from multiple sources (news, reddit, polymarket, X). Use for in-depth asset research and analysis.

widgets.name: calendar-invite
widgets.description: Display a calendar event invitation with date, time, attendees, and RSVP actions. Use for scheduling.

widgets.name: citation-card
widgets.description: Display an inline citation with expandable source details. Use when citing information from sources.

widgets.name: code-block
widgets.description: Display syntax-highlighted code with optional title and copy button.

widgets.name: crypto-blue-chips
widgets.description: Display a list of top cryptocurrencies with prices, 24h changes, market caps, and trading actions. Use for crypto overview dashboards.

widgets.name: crypto-chart
widgets.description: Display cryptocurrency price chart with market data, supply info, and trading actions. Use for crypto data.

widgets.name: data-table
widgets.description: Display tabular data with headers and rows. Use for structured data presentation.

widgets.name: email-draft
widgets.description: Display an email draft with recipient, subject, body, and send action. Use for email composition workflows.

widgets.name: lp-manager
widgets.description: Manage liquidity pool positions - collect fees, add/remove liquidity, close position. Use for DeFi LP management.

widgets.name: music-sample-selector
widgets.description: Browse and preview audio samples with waveforms, sort by key/tempo, adjust speed/pitch globally, and select samples.

widgets.name: photo-editor
widgets.description: Photo editor with brush masking and SAM-style point selection for marking regions. Supports brush tool with size presets (S/M/L/XL) and selection tool (left click=include, right click=exclude).

widgets.name: search-results
widgets.description: Display web search results with thumbnails, sources, and expandable cards. Use when displaying search engine results.

widgets.name: shopping-cart
widgets.description: Display a shopping cart with items, quantities, prices, and checkout action. Use for e-commerce flows.

widgets.name: shopping-item
widgets.description: Display a single product item with image, price, and add-to-cart action. Use for product recommendations.

widgets.name: solana-wallet
widgets.description: Display Solana wallet overview with balance, tokens, recent transactions, and actions. Use for crypto wallet views.

widgets.name: stock-chart
widgets.description: Display stock price chart with key metrics, price change, and trading actions. Use for financial data.

widgets.name: token-swap
widgets.description: Display a token swap interface with input/output tokens, amounts, rates, and swap action. Use for DeFi swaps.

widgets.name: video-editor
widgets.description: Video editor with timeline, keyframes, brush masking, and SAM-style point selection. Supports frame-by-frame navigation, play/pause, and per-frame annotations.

widgets.name: weather-card
widgets.description: Display current weather conditions for a location. Use when showing weather information.
